email.subject: Family Group Dentistry: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I checked Family Group Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no online booking, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next dentist, and there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to copy your number instead of tapping to dial. Your hours aren't listed either, which adds friction for new patients deciding where to go.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
